title: Low Pressure Turbine (LPT) Thermal Creep & Outlet Temperature Surge

telemetry_indicators.sensor_4: Total temperature at LPT outlet exceeds 1410.0 deg R (nominal 1395 - 1405 deg R)
telemetry_indicators.sensor_21: LPT Coolant bleed drops below nominal cooling flow

root_causes: Turbine blade thermal barrier coating (TBC) spallation and severe oxidation
Blocked or choked secondary cooling bleed passages in stage 2 nozzle guide vanes
Gas path thermal fatigue causing inter-stage seal degradation
dispatch_protocol: Immediate AOG (Aircraft On Ground) alert if sensor_4 exceeds 1420 deg R. Mandatory boroblend or replacement.
inspection_procedure: Step 1: Inspect LPT Stage 1 and 2 nozzle guide vanes (NGV) for trailing-edge burning or molten spatter.
Step 2: Check LPT coolant flow path using thermal imaging or pressurized argon leak detection.
Step 3: Measure Exhaust Gas Temperature (EGT) margin at takeoff rated thrust.
Step 4: Verify thermocouples calibration on Sensor 4 harness connectors.

replacement_parts.part_name: Thermal Barrier Ceramic Shroud Tile Kit

safety_advisories: Allow minimum 4 hours cool-down before borescope insertion into turbine gas path to prevent lens damage.
